League Schedule Engine

Schedule Builder

Preserve the fixed Draft Slot round robin, run the inverse-order cross-tier Schedule Draft, and generate a complete Weeks 1–14 schedule without manual matchup juggling.

2026 · Builder v1
Step 1

League Setup

Draft Slot drives Weeks 1–9. Prior-year finish determines the two Weeks 10–14 tiers. Yahoo names are only used for the Yahoo output view.

OwnerDraft Slot2025 FinishTierYahoo Team Name
Weeks 1–9

Fixed Draft-Slot Round Robin

This matrix is locked to your historical format. Every draft slot plays every other draft slot exactly once.

Step 2

Cross-Tier Schedule Draft

Selections proceed in inverse fantasy draft-slot order. Once an owner is paired, they are skipped later in the order. The first locked pair becomes the Week 10 crossover, the second Week 11, and so on.

Locked Pairings
The engine builds Weeks 10–14 after the five crossover pairs are known, so any currently available opposite-tier owner is a valid choice and the draft cannot dead-end.
Step 3

Final 2026 Schedule

Complete the five crossover pairings to generate Weeks 10–14.

Validation

Matchup Count Matrix

Each cell shows how many times the row owner faces the column owner across Weeks 1–14. Expected counts are 1 or 2; anything else is flagged.
